mitigation_descriptions: Manage the creation, modification, use, and permissions associated to user accounts to limit access to sensitive credential stores.
Restrict sudo access and administrative privileges to prevent unauthorized users from accessing privileged system files.
Ensure permissions on sensitive system files such as /etc/shadow are restricted to the root user only and cannot be accessed via unmonitored sudo rules.
reasoning: Adversarial review confirmed that account blord executed unauthorized sudo commands to access /etc/shadow on intranet-server, indicating OS credential dumping (T1003.008). Immediate containment is required to isolate the compromised account and prevent potential lateral movement or offline password cracking.
remediation_plan: 1. Isolate the host intranet-server (172.21.241.88) from the network to prevent further credential misuse or lateral movement. 2. Terminate all active sessions for user blord and temporarily disable the account. 3. Review and revoke excessive sudo privileges configured for blord in /etc/sudoers. 4. Force a password reset for all accounts stored in /etc/shadow on intranet-server due to credential exposure. 5. Inspect authentication and command logs on intranet-server for subsequent unauthorized actions or exfiltration attempts.
